description: Azure ARM template security check — Static security review of an Azure Resource Manager template (template= JSON or url=; nested resources included). Flags storage HTTP/old TLS/public blob access/open network, public containers, NSG rules open to the Internet (SSH/RDP/DB ports), SQL firewall 0.0.0.0-255.255.255.255, hard-coded admin passwords, Key Vault soft-delete/purge protection, App Service httpsOnly/FTP/remote debugging, AKS RBAC and public API, Cosmos DB and Redis exposure, Owner role assignments, string-typed secret parameters and secrets in outputs. Returns findings with fixes, score, grade and verdict. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_arm_check
